balls.text: SRH do get past 200 in the end as Unadkat lofts the fuller length ball outside off to the left of long-off. The throw from the deep is wide and they complete two easily
Fuller in length outside off, he can only push this back to the bowler
Oof, he's laced that over the bowler's head for a couple of runs. Was a fuller-length ball and Unadkat lifts this neatly to the right of long-off who does well to save two
Sharp yorker on leg stump, he misses the flick and is hit on the pad as they pinch in a leg-bye
Good length ball just outside off, he lofts this over extra cover for two more as SRH inch towards 200
Length ball just outside off, he carves this over point for a couple of runs

Kohli drops Aniket, he takes Aniket. On a length outside off stump, Aniket looks to clear long-off but doesn't get enough power behind it. Wasn't that flourish that Aniket has found all innings. Kohli completes a comfortable catch

Goes for the reverse switch hit and misses. And the umpire gives that a wide. Oof, that's a harsh call, I think. Patidar reviews. Fuller and just outside the tramline, but Aniket had moved as well. That means a revised guideline for the wide comes into play and the ball is well inside it. The on-field umpire's decision is reversed.
Going, going, gone! My word, what hitting. In the slot right on off stump, he plays the no-look straight hit and fetches another six with the ball going over the sight screen
Six followed by four. Slower bouncer outside off stump, he slices that over point and the ball just bounces inside the boundary cushion around the deep backward point region
In the slot and Aniket has laid into that! Slower offcutter but that was right in Aniket's arc outside off. He clears his front leg and ABSOLUTELY smokes him for a 100m six over wide long-on
Fuller on the stumps, he squeezes this to long-on
Length ball on off stump, he pushes this firmly to long-off
Harshal falls for a two-ball duck and SRH lose their eighth. Slower back of a length ball outside off, Harshal gets no power behind that shot and only hits it as far as long-off
Slower back of a length ball outside off, he mistimes to extra cover

Straight up and Kohli has dropped a relatively simple chance according to his standards. On a length on off stump, he looks to clear long-on but ends up hitting it straight up. Kohli runs in from long-on, settles under the high ball and spills it
Ramped over the 'keeper's head for another four. Bangs the slower knuckle ball at 117.4kph on off stump. It is over his head, but Aniket watches this closely and plonks his bat to clear the keeper.
Starts off with a slower length ball at 108.5kph outside off, Aniket laces the uppish drive to the left of long-off for a couple of runs

Another ones bites the dust and Dubey's innings lasts just three balls. Dubey gets across but Shepherd spots him and bowls a full-length ball on leg stump. He flicks this uppishly, not with a lot of control and Padikkal takes takes the simplest of catches at the deep backward square leg fence
Slower delivery landed on a back of a length well outside off, Dubey gets across and pulls to the right of Salt who gets across from the deep midwicket area for a couple of runs
Slower but very wide outside off stump, called a wide
Slower back of a length ball on off stump, he pulls to deep midwicket
On a length angling away from Dubey, he drives to deep cover
Yorker on middle stump, he ticks this towards deep midwicket for a run
Aniket is not holding back! Length ball down leg, he gets inside the line of that and helps him over deep backward square leg for a big six

Hang on a minute, I need to pick up my jaw from the floor. PHIL SALT, where's your cape! How's he taken that? A one-handed stunner right at the deep backward point boundary to dismiss the SRH captain. If there was any doubt about Salt's previous catch, there is none this time. Low full toss outside off stump, Kishan carves that again this time over point. The ball was going to the fence for all money but Salt hares to his right around the deep backward point region, plucks out his right hand, almost parallel to the ground and grabs it with minimum of fuss. WOWZA!
Oof, that's wrist work at its finest! My word, how's he got that for six! Length ball outside off, he carves that over short third and gets it all the way
Sharp short of a length ball on off stump, Aniket mistimes his pull to the left of Salt at deep midwicket but only for a run
Lands the yorker on middle stump and Aniket just about squeezes this to backward point. Oh, Kishan is way down the track and scampers back quickly. Shepherd's throw is way off the mark though
WHACKED! Banged in short just around waist high, Aniket gets into position nice and early and hammers the pull over deep midwicket for a huge six
Angles the length ball into Aniket on off stump, he presents the full face of the bat and pushes to cover
Flatter and shorter bowled at 101kph on off, he flat-bats this to long-on

Neatly done. Floated length ball outside off, Aniket waits for it and at the last moment opens the face of the blade and runs this in the gap between backward point and short third to get off the mark
Another drag down and Suyash gets away with it again. Short and very wide, Aniket looks to cut that hard and is beaten

Straight to deep midwicket and RCB continue to strike. Arora comes and goes Dragged down googly on off stump, Arora's eyes light up as he looks to smash that out of Chinnaswamy. Ends up losing his shape and clatters it straight to Padikkal who moves forward and takes a relatively simple catch
Googly on a length on off stump, turning away, Kishan pats this towards point
Fuller tossed up delivery on off, he looks for a drive, instead gets a thick inside-edge behind square
Short of a good length ball outside off, he pushes towards backward point
Arora gets his boundary counter running. Banged in short on off stump, he pulls again, gets a big fat top-edge and the ball goes over deep fine leg. Arora not in control there, but he will take it
Back of a length ball angling across Kishan who cuts this to deep point
Banged in short on off stump, he pulls towards Salt at deep backward square leg, he hares forward trying to go for the catch but the ball just falls short.
On a length on the stumps, he flicks this to short midwicket

Has Salt taken a screamer at the deep midwicket fence? Salt likes it but he was very close to the boundary cushion. Slower offcutter on off stump, Klaasen looks to mow that across the line, but courtesy of the lack of pace, gets more height than distance. Salt is right on the boundary edge and makes the catch more difficult than it is. The ball bobbles in his hand, and he ends up swatting on the boundary edge and completes the catch. The third umpire is checking, waiting for multiple angles to check if any part of Salt's body or his shirt was touching the boundary cushions. He is very close to those cushions... but looks like he is fine. The third umpire is happy and sends Klaasen on his way. This was too close for comfort, but I think the third umpire got this decision right. Salt actually showed great presence of mind to not tumble too close to the cushion
In the arc and out of the park! Right in Kishan's wheelhouse on off stump, he extends his arms and sends Krunal straight down the ground for another six
Krunal goes very low but Kishan goes very long. This is Krunal's low-arm slinger but the line is down leg and Kishan gets inside the line and swats it for a huge six over deep backward square leg
Darted in off stump, Klassen gives himself room and crashes this to deep cover
Length ball on off stump, Kishan loses his shape in trying to hack this across the line. Ends up mistiming to deep midwicket
Flatter outside off, he punches to deep extra cover for a run
Easy pickings and Klaasen takes full toll! Juicy knee-high full toss on off stump, he lines him up and hammers this miles over cow corner
Poor delivery to end the over and Kishan cashes in! Dragged down leg stump, Kishan gets inside the line and pulls to the deep backward square leg fence
Short and wide, Kishan cuts him to backward point

Oh, miscommunication but no harm done as Klaasen dives to make his ground! Tossed up on off, he pushes to covers and Klaasen is off for a run. He is sent back and dives with the throw hitting him. He didn't change his path so all good.
Inside out and gets four more. This is clinical! Floated outside off, he shimmies down the track and lofts this with ease over covers

Smashed back past the bowler and Kishan gets to a 27-ball fifty. He continues his golden run of form, now as SRH captain. Was tossed up on the fuller side on middle stump, he stays leg side of the ball and tonks this to the right of the bowler
Flatter on leg stump, he works this to the left of square leg where the fielder dives early but keeps the batters to a run
Oof, just past Pandya's outstretched left hand. Tossed up on the fuller side on off, Klaasen pushes this aerially but to the left of Pandya who dives full-length but the ball evades him
Short and wide again angling away from Kishan's hitting arc. He slashes that sweeper cover
Fullish in length on middle stump, Klaasen eases this to long-off for a run
Flatter 104kph delivery, was shortish and well outside off as he thumps this to long-off
Darted length ball on the stumps, he pushes to long-off
Flatter length ball on off stump, he chops this down onto the surface towards cover
Looped full around off, looks to drive it to long-off. Hits it back to the bowler
Pulled in the gap, good stop to the left by deep square leg. A touch short, Kishan quick on the pull. All along the ground
Quick and short. Seam-y ball just outside off, 103ks, punched to long-off
Back of length outside off, slapped to deep point
Rips it and gives it air but Kishan is able to mash it into the ground. Wide of long-off. Kishan almost getting on one knee, weight fully forward and drove it with a heavy bottom hand
Length outside off, 92ks, the googly spins away and guides it to backward point
Wide and full, looks to scythe it through point. Under-edge goes to the right of the keeper and to short fine leg. Timeout
Tucks it off the back foot through midwicket for a smart two
Catch is the call but it's split deep midwicket and long-on. Pace on, just outside off and on the rise. Kishan opened his stance and swiped across his ribs
Looks to pull it, inside edges it onto pad. Ball rolls to the off side. Abhinandan going into the pitch again, 140ks, around off
Full toss slips out. The attempted yorker is high on the pads, the slower ball is punched towards midwicket
Shortish 137ks ball at the stumps, pulled to deep midwicket
Doesn't go through with the pull, gets it through midwicket. Hits the outfield
And again! Punchy off-drive races along the ground. Not a half-volley but Klaasen is steady and firm. Checks the shot, nobody move
Driven through the line. Slung in fullish on off, Klaasen waits and shows the full face and the ball races to the bowler's left
Length outside off, cut to deep point
Uses the pace and steers it through backward point. Not much room on that back of length ball, Kishan stood around leg stump and caressed it
Pitched up at the stumps, punched to long-on
Pulls the shortish ball to deep square leg
Leading edge almost goes back to the bowler. Back of length at the body, Klaasen looks to flick it square. Didn't power it
Might've been an edge but that jagged back. Wobble ball landed on a length around middle and came in. Kishan tried to defend but sliced the ball right to left. Ball went off the pad towards third
A touch wide on a back of length, square driven to deep point. 135ks
Back of length outside off, cut late to deep third
Klaasen doesn't muscle the pull, clears the infield and gets it to deep square leg. Back of length at the body
Length on leg, maybe a bit of swing in, flicked to midwicket
Lowish full toss outside off, square driven to point
Now he uses the pace to carve it over third. It's a calculated edge. Shortish ball just outside off, Kishan tried to go over point, powered the swing fully
Kishan has much more time for this pull, gets it over the infield and in front of square. Long chase for Duffy from midwicket in vain.
At the hips and that's launched! Kishan gets upright, swivels and pulls it high behind square for an 89-metre six
Short ball almost does the trick again! At the stumps, zipping off the pitch at 139ks. Kishan looked to pull it aerially, gets it to midwicket. Lands a few feet in front of the fielder running in
Shortish ball doesn't bounce much and is slow off the pitch, beats the flick and goes off the legs
Comes back in and gets extra bounce, Kishan taken aback as he springs back but manages to extend his bat horizontally and run it through to deep third
Shepherd saves one, ran from cover till the boundary before pulling it in. Good shot by Klaasen, no footwork but showed the full face to the ball. Punched it off a fullish length in the gap
Swinging away. Length ball at fifth stump, let go

Short ball works again, Third for Duffy! 134ks back of length ball at the body, rose around belly-height, Nitish's feet were in the crease as he tried to pull it aerially. Stayed up for a mile, midwicket came in and took a simple catch.
Back of length just outside off, pushed towards point
Length on off, flicked to midwicket
Cuts it hard, finds point. Good diving stop to the left from Duffy
Length on off, defended to the off side
Pokes and gets beaten Seam away, the wobble ball lands on a length outside off, Nitish tried to push it to cover. Got his hands away from the body
Punched off the back foot to cover for a quick single
Square driven on top of the bounce, finds the gap through cover. At first, it looked like it'll go to the fielder but no. Nothing wrong with the ball - on a length, just outside off

Head's snipered it straight to deep square leg! The crowd erupts! Duffy turning it on at the Chinnaswamy. 136ks back of length ball just outside off, Head pulled it hard and flat. Salt took it with cupped hands around his chest and fell back with the momentum but held on. Travishek done for the night
No room, on the rise, splatted downtown! Patidar still applauds. Was a fullish ball on off, Head cleared his front foot and whacked it with a diagonal bat. Nearly a six
No room, beaten again. Touch back of length, scrambled seam over middle and leg. Head makes room and tries to pull it, doesn't have the bounce to connect
Length on leg, Head makes room and drives to cover. Krunal keeps Kishan in check with a throw
Away swing, wide on a length, Kishan guides it to deep-backward point

Straight up, Jitesh underneath and takes it looking back! RCB have tucked up Abhishek and have now removed him! Scrambled seam 133ks back of length ball just outside off, Abhishek in the crease, looking to pull it. Bat face opened on impact and he sliced it behind. His lean patch continues
RCB losing their line regularly. Back of length down leg, Abhishek gets inside the line and looks to pull. Misses
French cut and Head twirls around and smiles to see his fortune. Was a length ball outside off that he tried to guide it through point with a horizontal bat, got an under-edge
Tucking him up. Abhishek in the crease, looks to pull it from leg stump. Wanted to go square or behind, misses
Well down leg, Jitesh has to dive to the right. Swing but the initial direction of the ball a touch too straight
Ball skids to beat the pull, hits the pad and pops up. Lands leg side of the stumps. Was a back of length ball that hit the thigh pad. Abhishek swivelled and lost his shape
Walks down and looks to whip it fine, the length ball swings down leg
Guides it to deep third. Used the pace and direction of the 133ks length ball nicely, from just outside off
Dances down early, Bhuvi may have seen him. Goes a touch back of length, swings it away towards off. Pats it towards point
Stump to stump. Outswinger on a length lands around leg and finishes around off. Head looks to defend straight, thick inside edge goes through square leg
Full toss swings in towards off stump, driven to cover point
Wide and fullish, looks to carve it over point and misses
Slashed away and clears the deep-backward-point boundary. This was full and wide, no swing, Abhishek got on one knee, didn't swing too hard, followed through fully though

Keeper asks for the caught behind, Jitesh is convinced. Can he convince Patidar? Yes. Very loud out there. Was a length ball just outside off, Abhishek opened the bat face and wanted to run it to third. Ball close to bat... but flat line detected on Ultra-Edge.
More swing but this is a touch too straight, full ball beats the attempted aerial flick and goes off the pad to short fine leg. Replay shows there was a tickle
Bit of swing in. Fullish fourth-stump ball at 133ks, pushed to point with an open face

That's that! Defending champions start IPL 2026 with a statement win. At the halfway mark, the question was is 200 enough? The way RCB went about the chase, even 250 wasn't going to be enough tonight. They have galloped past the 202 target in 15.4 overs and with some style. Kohli ends the game with another boundary. Slower short ball outside off, he ramps this over short third and ends with an unbeaten 69 off 38. RCB win  by six wickets with 26 balls to spare.
Oh, my word! This is a shot and a half.. Kohli at his finest. Length ball outside off, he jumps down the track and goes aerially over covers with minimum of fuss
Banged in short but the line is down leg, he helps this with ease over the keeper's head for four more
On-pace 127kph ball right in his wheelhouse. Kohli gets under it and with a clean swing of the blade smashes him over long-on
Back of a length ball angling across Kohli, he gets this to deep cover
Banged in short outside off, he pulls to deep midwicket

Dropped by Nitish Reddy at the deep extra cover fence and ends up ticking it over the fence as well for six. Nothing going right for him tonight. Slower length ball angling across David. He slices this with power over extra cover, not the cleanest of connections though. Reddy sprints to his right, gets both hands to it but shells it and parries the ball over the boundary cushion.

A tennis forehand and David gets four to his name. Slower bouncer well outside off, he finally gets a clean chunk of it and flat-bats it to the right of cover. Reddy gets across and comically goes outside the boundary ropes, trying to stop that.
Another day, another fifty for Kohli... no 64 in the IPL for him. He starts IPL 2026 the way he left the previous season Gets to his fifty by pulling Payne to deep midwicket
Slower bouncer angling across David outside off. He flat-bats this to mid-off, loses his shape completely in doing that
Slower offuctter again, was back of a length outside off, he pulls to deep midwicket

Slower bouncer but that is too high even for the lanky David, going over his head. Called a wide, but Kishan reviews. SRH only have a review left, so he might think this is close. He is wrong. Comfortably and wide and SRH have now lost both reviews, both on wides.
Another offcutter, was a back of a length ball outside off, he mistimes this to sweeper cover
Slower bouncer banged in short around off stump shoulder-high. He taps this to backward point and sets off only to be sent back by David
On the fuller side of length, David brings out his big bat swing but mistimes it just over the bowler's head on the bounce
On-pace length ball on off stump, he eases this to long-on
Slower back of a length ball on off stump, he pulls to deep midwicket for a run
Slower length ball on middle and leg, he works this with soft hands to deep midwicket. After an 18-run opening over, Payne has returned with a two run and two wicket over.
Back of a length ball on off stump, he stands tall and pushes to extra cover
Length ball on off stump, he pats this to cover

Aaaand he falls first ball. Payne suddenly has two in two and is on a hat-trick. Banged in short hip-high down leg, Jitesh pulls but is unable to control it and helps this straight down Unadkat's throat at deep backward square leg

Straight up and Payne has his first IPL wicket. Slower 120.7kph length ball angling away from Patidar's arc. In the form that he is, he is looking to smash everything out of his presence. Tries to hammer that away but only spoons it straight up. Dubey runs back and sideways and takes a good catch
Banged in short on off, he pulls towards long-on
The over finally ends, 22 off that! Slower back of a length ball outside off, he flat-bats this to wide long-off
On-pace fuller-length ball but again that is past the tramline outside off. Called a wide.
Slower offcutter outside off, he gets across and works to deep midwicket with soft hands

What hitting this is from captain Patidar. It's a proper exhibition from him tonight. Length ball on his pad and Patidar needs no second invitation there. Shuffles slightly across and dismisses this out his presence over deep midwicket

Goes back to his slower delivery, this one a length ball well outside off stump. Patidar looks for an aerial drive and misses. The umpire deems that is a wide. Kishan reviews, but he isn't getting in his favour. Was well outside the tramline outside off.

In the arc, waaaay out of the park. Patidar is looking in ominous form! Malinga goes pace-on, at 133kph, but that is again in his wheelhouse on middle. Patidar gets under it and smashes over wide long-on
Another slower bouncer goes awry! Very short and very high outside off, called a wide
Slower good length ball at 108.7kph around off stump, Patidar can only swish that towards extra cover
Slower bouncer but that is too short and too high over the batter's head
Freebie to start with and Patidar ain't missing out on those, not tonight! Right in the slot on off and middle, he gets right under it and pummels this straight over the bowler's head
Good riposte but the damage is done in that over. Lands the length ball on off and turns it away past Kohli's outside edge
Going, going out of here! Floated on off stump, Kohli gives Dubey the charge, reaches the pitch of the ball and smokes him straight over his head for a huge six
Pushed quicker outside off, he eases to extra cover
Fuller on middle and leg, he looks thrash across the line again but can't get under it. The goes flat and quick in between deep midwicket and long-on
There goes the spin basher and gets six to his name. Right in Patidar's slot on middle stump, he brings out the slog sweep and thrashes this over cow corner
Shimmies down the track to the length ball on middle and pushes this to long-off
Wide and full, Kohli dances forward and slaps it to deep point
Dug deep into the pitch, spongy bounce and well outside off. Let go
Slower yorker just outside off, knocked to long-on
Cut in the gap to the left of deep point. Harshal left without answers. Cutter on a length outside off, Patidar waits for the ball to arrive next to him and times it to perfection
Steps out and pulls it to deep midwicket
Picked up for a flat six. Crowd adores it. It's a length ball arrowing in at the body, Kohli pecking forward late to get his weight forward and then getting his hands through quickly
Neatly timed punch takes the length ball to the left of long-on
Makes room and looks for the cut. Length ball is at the stumps, he half-cuts it back to the bowler
Pitched up at the stumps, punched to long-on

Taken at long-off and Padikkal's party is over. He grimaces and walks back. Ball was there to hit. Overpitched and at the stumps, Padikkal showed all three stumps and went for a drive through line. Got it too low, easy catch
Slog sweeps it behind square. Didn't take a far enough stride but lunged through and picked it off a length
Looks to cut it hard, gets a thick edge. MIght've been intentional as his head swerved back early. Ball too fine for short third
Driven to long-off and RCB bring up hundred early
Carves it off the back foot, from outside off to cover
Kishan lets it go through between his feet. Last time it was the opposite, both times he's conceded four. Was a shortish ball outside off that Padikkal tried to cut. Beat him and nutmegged Kishan

Padikkal gets to a 21-ball fifty with an imperious straight drive. Turns around and raises his bat as the ball thuds into the fence. Harshal misses the yorker, ends up under-pitching and it's driven through the line
Klaasen misjudges it and drops it at long-on. Stayed back too long early on, then realises he has to run forward, dives forward but the ball doesn'y carry.
Wide yorker, just inside the tramline. Bat jams the ground as Kohli tries to squeeze it behind point. Bowler and keeper appeal for caught behind, no response
Shortish ball outside off, pulled to deep square leg
Gets out of the crease, tries to pull the shortish ball to midwicket. Ball goes into the ground, to the bowler's right
Masterful lofted straight drive! It's a check hit with a straight bat, finishes just beyond the perpendicular. Get the weight forward check, high elbow check, hold the shape check
Pitched up on middle and leg, flicked to deep square leg's left. Not a clean collection and that allows two
Slower bouncer outside off, Kohli read it and wanted to cut it late and in the air. Misses
Wide and slow on a length, gets his back leg out and then his torso reaches out to cut it to backward point
DDP continues in his merry way. Cuts it through backward point. Ball not that wide.
Makes room, drives the full ball to mid-off. Timeout
Chipped over the ring at midwicket, deep fielder runs left to stop it. Was a length ball that Kohli didn't time fully. Bat turned in a touch
Low full toss on leg, flicked to wide long-on
Looks to go down the ground as the fullish ball was at the stumps. He was leg side of the ball, gets an inside edge to square leg
Dances down and gets a yorked. Ball darted proper. Manages to jam it off the toe to short third
Greeted with a sweep. Gets inside the line of a fullish ball on off, on one knee quickly and whacks it behind square for a two-bounce four
Looks to pull it from the stumps, misses and the ball trickles closeby. Batters aware, pinch a quick single

Skids past Kishan, no spin off the pitch but went in like a legcutter after half-volleying the keeper. He was standing with feet stuck and the upper-body leaning forward. No contact. Was a bouncer outside off that beat the cut
Dances down again, this time it's a bouncer from around the wicket that greets him. He pulls it wristily from around head-height to midwicket
Opens up the off-side by dancing down and slapping it. Back of length over middle stump, Kohli has room and slaps it through cover point. Fifty partnership up
Slower one's been slog swept. Takes a big stride forward, crouches a bit and smokes the fullish ball over midwicket. 72-metre six
Looks to heave it across, the bat turns inwards. Length ball outside off goes to midwicket. Fifty up for RCB
Dances down and picks it up with panache! Slower one and he instinctively waited for the fullish ball to arrive, then flicks it high and far over midwicket
Slower length ball on off, Kohli lunges forward and taps it to cover
Makes room, gets followed by a back of length ball at the body. Pulled to deep square leg
No relent! Padikkal's using the crease superbly and powering the ball. Gets to fourth stump, bends his back leg for the pull as it's a length ball, not short. Whacked through midwicket
Somehow clears deep-backward point. Padikkal toed that having come down the track in pre-meditated fashion. He then got on one knee, reached out and scythed the full, wide ball
Good ball. Inswinging length ball on leg, 126ks, defended with a straight bat
Length just outside off, guides it to deep third
Padikkal's come out with purpose and elite skill. He's getting just outside off stump, allows him to get beside the full ball and then drives it over mid-off
Kohli is annoyed with himself having missed out on the flick. Took a step down and tried to chip it behind square, fullish ball hit him on the pad
Walks across, covers off stump and punches the fourth-stump length ball to deep third. Nitish falls in follow-through
"Yes boy" Kohli goes as the ball runs to the fine leg boundary. Was a full ball on middle, Padikkal very whippy with the flick. Kept the bat face closed to get the ball fine
Yorker on middle, 133ks, flicked to deep backward square. Nitish getting his pace up
Pitched up on off, 132ks, pushed to cover
Gets on the front stool and authoritatively belts it wide of mid-off. Fuller side of length just outside off, just enough room to free the arms
Shortish and angling in into the body, flicked to the leg side
Pitched up on off, defended to mid-on for a quick single
Padikkal needs no sighters. Stands still, waits for the full ball to slide slightly down leg, and helps it with a flick over backward square leg

Spliced... collision, and Klaasen takes it anyway! Klaasen says to Aniket he couldn't hear the call. Aniket's hands didn't hit the head as Klaasen was going down. Length ball outside off, Salt wanted to launch it over cover but spliced it. Catch was taken low to the left
Pitched up and down leg, Salt looks to whip it fine. Misses, ball goes off pad to the keeper's left
Touch too short, touch too wide. Salt stands tall and slaps it nonchalantly through cover
Full and at the stumps, whipped to mid-on
A bit of with and that's slashed through cover point.
Looks to get it past cover, along the ground. The fielder does well, moved to the right and stopped it. Salt ran halfway down and then back
Length outside off, defended back to the bowler
